duration.text: The Civil Engineering at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: * Copy of ordinary passport with at least 12 months validity.Highest diploma/degree ( Applicants that have not graduatedshould provide a study certificate/pre-graduation certificate.).Academic transcripts.Language proficiency certificate. Financial support statement. Employment certificate or non-criminal record required fromthose graduated over l2 months. Foreigner Physical Examination Form (if available)
